title: Forge Agent DNA (v1)
description: The central contract of Forge: a complete, declarative agent definition. The runtime executes only what a document valid against this schema declares. Fail-closed governance fields are const-locked: a definition literally cannot disable them.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the catalog.

slug.description: Stable machine identifier; unique per tenant. Never changes across versions.

version.description: Semver of this definition. Any change to the document requires a new version; historical runs reference the exact version that produced them (FR-A3).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Multi-tenant-ready (NFR-4); a single tenant is active in v1.

type.description: Interaction pattern: conversational (chatbot), triggered pipeline (workflow), or self-directed within guardrails (autonomous).

description.description: What this agent does, for the catalog and for evaluators.

system_blocks.description: Ordered references to reusable, versioned instruction blocks (policy, tone) shared across agents (FR-A5).

task_prompt.description: Agent-specific task instructions. Must reference governed knowledge by rule ID (R-xxx), never restate rule content — rules live in the knowledge layer, versioned and owned.

tools.description: Explicit tool grants — least privilege (FR-C3). A tool absent from this list does not exist for the agent. All invocations pass through the tool gateway (FR-C1).

ref.description: Reference to a tool contract in the gateway registry.

autonomy.description: autonomous: gateway executes after validation. requires_approval: every invocation enters the HITL queue (FR-E2). forbidden: explicit denial, recorded so reviewers see the tool was considered and refused.

config.description: Optional per-agent tool configuration, validated by the tool's own config schema at the gateway.

collections.description: Knowledge collections this agent may retrieve from. Each collection carries owner, date, and authority level metadata (FR-D1).

authority_policy.description: Const-locked: on conflicting sources, the highest-authority source wins (sme_validated > policy_2023 > policy_2019); conflicts are surfaced, never silently averaged (FR-D2, R-090).

provider.description: LLM gateway adapter to use (ADR-005). API keys live only in gateway config, never here.

model_id.description: Provider-specific model identifier, resolved by the gateway adapter.

max_tokens_per_run.description: Hard token budget per run, enforced by the LLM gateway (FR-B3).

max_cost_usd_per_run.description: Hard cost ceiling per run; exceeding it stops the run and escalates.

max_cost_usd_per_day.description: Hard daily cost ceiling for this agent across all runs; exceeding it suspends further runs.

max_steps.description: Hard limit on reasoning-loop iterations per run (FR-B3).

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit per run; on timeout the run escalates, it never silently completes.

escalate_on_no_rule_match.description: Const-locked fail-closed default (R-091): when no rule matches or confidence is low, escalate — never guess, never execute.

require_citations.description: Const-locked (R-092): every decision must cite the rule ID(s) applied; a decision without citations is rejected by the runtime.

suite_ref.description: The evaluation suite this agent version must pass (FR-F1).

publish_gate.description: Const-locked (FR-F2): a version that fails its suite cannot be published. Not configurable — governance as a structural property.

versioned_ref.description: Reference to a registered artifact by slug, optionally pinned to a semver (`slug` or `slug@1.2.0`). Unpinned refs resolve to the latest published version at run start and are pinned in the run record.
